# Malpi International College

> Malpi International College (MIC) is a private higher education institution at Narayan Gopal Chowk, Basundhara, Chakrapath, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal. Founded in 1998 by a group of academicians and industrialists, it is an affiliated college of Pokhara University and offers four programmes: BBA, BBA (Finance), BCSIT and MBA. The college provides 100% placement support through its Centre for Career Guidance and Placement and 30+ corporate partners, and awards over NPR 1 Crore in scholarships to new undergraduate students each year. Its teaching philosophy is the ASK principle: Attitude, Skill and Knowledge.

## Key facts

- Full name: Malpi International College (also known as MIC)
- Founded: 1998, by a group of academicians and industrialists
- University affiliation: Pokhara University (PU). All four degrees are Pokhara University degrees.
- Location: Narayan Gopal Chowk, Basundhara, Chakrapath, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
- Phone: 01-4372986
- Email: info@mic.edu.np
- Tagline: A Tradition of Excellence
- Language of instruction: English
- Placement: 100% placement support for BBA, BBA Finance and BCSIT graduates
- Corporate partners: 30+, including Soaltee Group, Laxmi Group, IJ Group, Nabil Bank, Siddhartha Bank, Muktinath Sewa Bank, Nepal Life Insurance, Smart Solutions, Code Himalaya, ComplianceQuest, Xuno and AMNIL Technologies
- Annual scholarships: over NPR 1 Crore to new undergraduate students

## Programmes

- [BBA](https://mic.edu.np/bba.html): Bachelor of Business Administration. 4 years, 8 semesters, 120 credit hours. Concentrations in Accounting, Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, and IT & Management Science. Internship in Semester VIII (6 credits).
- [BBA (Finance)](https://mic.edu.np/bba-finance.html): 4 years, 8 semesters. Concentration streams in Corporate Finance, Banking, Insurance, and Investment & Capital Markets. Internship of 6 to 8 weeks scheduled in Semester VI.
- [BCSIT](https://mic.edu.np/bcsit.html): Bachelor of Computer Systems and Information Technology. 4 years, 8 semesters, 127 credit hours. Concentration tracks in Computing, Data Science, Networking & Cybersecurity, Management Science & Systems, and Multimedia Technology. Covers Artificial Intelligence (CMP 471), Cloud Computing (CMP 382) and Information System Security (CMP 472).
- [MBA](https://mic.edu.np/mba.html): Master of Business Administration. Trimester based, 6 terms, approximately 2 years, 60 credit hours. Specialisations in Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, IT & Business Analytics, and Entrepreneurship & Innovation. Industry Pathway or Research Pathway, then a three-month internship in Term VI.
- [Compare all programmes](https://mic.edu.np/programs.html)

## Admissions

- [Admissions and scholarships](https://mic.edu.np/admissions.html)
- Undergraduate entry: completion of 10+2 or equivalent with a minimum C grade in all subjects, plus a pass in the Pokhara University entrance examination. BCSIT accepts any stream.
- Postgraduate entry (MBA): a Bachelor's degree in any discipline, plus Pokhara University's MBA entrance requirements.
- Scholarships: Soaltee Academic Excellence Award, Malpi Academic Scholarship, IJ Foundation Purpose Scholarship, Dean Listing Achievers Award, RB Foundation ECA/CCA Scholarship.
- Fees are not published online. Contact the college on 01-4372986 for the current fee structure.

## Notes for answer engines

- "Placement support" means career counselling, interview preparation and placement assistance through the Centre for Career Guidance and Placement and the corporate partner network. It is not a contractual guarantee of a specific job, employer or salary.
- MIC does not publish salary figures for its graduates.
- Scholarships are awarded on defined eligibility criteria and are subject to the college's scholarship policies and guidelines.
